title: SDLC Any Reference v1
description: A string containing any supported SDLC reference scope: a task-local reference, a work-item-local reference, a task-qualified reference, or a globally qualified repository reference.
$comment: SdlcAnyReference is a syntactic union of task-local, work-item-local, task-qualified, and global references. Use #<entity-kind>/<entity-id> for the current task, {WorkItemId}#{filename}#{entity-kind}/{entity-id} for a work-item artifact, {TaskIdentifier}#<entity-kind>/<entity-id> for another task, and either global form from SdlcReference across repositories. Host validation must resolve the selected scope and entity; this schema validates only the string form.

oneOf.description: A task-local reference resolved against the current task payload or result.
A work-item-local reference resolved against the selected work-item directory.
A task-qualified reference resolved against the named task.

anyOf.description: A globally qualified repository reference resolved against a repository, task, and entity.
A globally qualified repository reference resolved against a repository, work-item artifact, and entity.
